parameters.name: demand_scale
parameters.source: detector count error ±0.05 as recorded in the study's data-quality artifact runs/p1_rehearsal/dq/data_quality.json (sha256 25328157d4df) (parameters.count_error; docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md §8.5), applied as one corridor-wide factor on every inflow
parameters.maps_to: factor on every network.inflow step and every on-ramp's inflow step (off-ramp exit fractions unchanged)

parameters.name: t_scale
parameters.source: assumed — runs/p1_rehearsal/transfer/transfer_check.json (sha256 1011d0cb3a57) (run on this population, artifacts/idm_i24_capacity.json (sha256 80a7579b7251)) gave no observed-interval range: no value of the mean time headway (T) in the measured range ∩ the simulated grid (not extrapolated) keeps the model's capacity per lane inside the observed interval 1418–1540 veh/h/lane; over it the model's capacity per lane spans 1591–1709 veh/h/lane (its range basis is measured_range_fallback, not an observed interval); so the wide transfer range of docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md §7.2 — the spread of individual drivers, which calibration may choose a population from — not a calibration uncertainty of this corridor's population, is used: the measured population artifacts/idm_i24.json (sha256 224a53dc6702; 12356 fitted episodes), source of the configured artifacts/idm_i24_capacity.json (sha256 80a7579b7251; 12356 fitted episodes) (sidecar artifacts/idm_i24_capacity.calibration.json; covariance shared, mean T / v0 scaled): mean T 1.511 ± 1 sd of its drivers (0.5212, the covariance diagonal) within CLAUDE.md §3.1's 0.8–2.2 — the measured range of docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md §7.2 (calibration.transfer_check.measured_range, MEASURED_RANGE_SIGMAS): T 0.99–2.032; as a factor on the configured mean 1.322
parameters.maps_to: factor on the passenger population's mean desired time headway T: a derived IDMCalibration (mean T x factor, covariance unchanged) as fleet.idm_calibration, or fleet.T for a scalar fleet; the heavy population unchanged

parameters.name: v0_scale
parameters.source: assumed — runs/p1_rehearsal/transfer/transfer_check.json (sha256 1011d0cb3a57) (run on this population, artifacts/idm_i24_capacity.json (sha256 80a7579b7251)) gave no observed-interval range: no value of the mean desired speed (v0) in the measured range keeps the model's free-flow speed inside the observed interval 29.16–29.27 m/s; over it the model's free-flow speed spans 23.38–24.58 m/s (its range basis is measured_range_fallback, not an observed interval); so the wide transfer range of docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md §7.2 — the spread of individual drivers, which calibration may choose a population from — not a calibration uncertainty of this corridor's population, is used: the measured population artifacts/idm_i24.json (sha256 224a53dc6702; 12356 fitted episodes), source of the configured artifacts/idm_i24_capacity.json (sha256 80a7579b7251; 12356 fitted episodes) (sidecar artifacts/idm_i24_capacity.calibration.json; covariance shared, mean T / v0 scaled): mean v0 32.4 ± 1 sd of its drivers (5.502, the covariance diagonal) within CLAUDE.md §3.1's 25–38 — the measured range of docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md §7.2 (calibration.transfer_check.measured_range, MEASURED_RANGE_SIGMAS): v0 26.9–37.9; as a factor on the configured mean 32.4
parameters.maps_to: factor on the passenger population's mean desired speed v0: a derived IDMCalibration (mean v0 x factor, covariance unchanged) as fleet.idm_calibration, or fleet.v0 for a scalar fleet; the heavy population unchanged
